description: Reopen r-sort-3b-lg (General) read-only. On T with Index IX_K, Seek "=" and ">=" with these keys: Long 1, 10 and 2, Integer 1, Byte 1, Double 1.0, Single 1.0, Currency 1, Boolean True, Date 1.5, the BSTRs "1" and "10" and "a", Empty, Null, no key at all, two keys ("a", 1) and two keys ("a", "b"); reads NoMatch and the ID of the current record after each. Asks how a key of another VARIANT type or a different key count is coerced, matched or refused on a one-column Text index.
retentionNote: Designed r-sort-3b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
